Even If This Love Disappears From the World Tonight

오늘 밤, 세계에서 이 사랑이 사라진다 해도

K-Drama · Movie · South Korea · 2025

⭐☆☆☆☆1B/10

Overview

High school student Han Seo-yoon suffers from anterograde amnesia after a tragic traffic accident, causing her memories to reset every morning. To continue living a normal life, she records every important event in diaries and computer notes. Her life changes after meeting Kim Jae-won, a quiet student who pretends to confess to her in order to stop the bullying of one of his classmates. What begins as a lie slowly turns into genuine love as Jae-won learns about Seo-yoon's condition and dedicates himself to creating precious memories for her, even knowing she will forget them the next day. Unknown to Seo-yoon, Jae-won is hiding a worsening heart condition. After his death, he leaves one final request to Seo-yoon's best friend—to erase every trace of him from Seo-yoon's life so she will never have to relive the pain of losing him each day. Although she completely forgets him, her heart continues to remember someone she can no longer name.

My Review

This adaptation completely shattered me. I already knew the story because of the Japanese version, but the Korean adaptation still managed to make me cry just as much. The most heartbreaking part wasn't Jae-won's death—it was his final wish. Instead of wanting Seo-yoon to remember him forever, he chose to disappear from her memories so she wouldn't have to suffer every single day. That kind of love is both beautiful and devastating. The fact that Ji-min honored his request by deleting every trace of him from Seo-yoon's computer, diary, and phone made the ending even more painful. Watching Seo-yoon unknowingly draw someone she no longer remembered proved that even if memories disappear, genuine love leaves a mark on the heart. I honestly couldn't move on after finishing this film.

Favorite Scene/Part

• Jae-won's fake confession slowly turning into genuine love. • Seo-yoon writing every memory of Jae-won in her diary and computer notes. •Ji-min returning Seo-yoon's memories after her condition improves. • Seo-yoon revisiting the beach and imagining Jae-won tying her shoelaces one last time. • The way Jae-won loved Seo-yoon.

Favorite Quote/Lines

"If they forget you little by little, then I will remember you little by little."
